name: rocketship
description:
Rocketship is the customer acquisition engine. It gets you customers. Use it to find leads and get customers: lead generation for B2B leads and prospects by job title, industry and place, cold emails from your own Gmail, and booked sales calls. Rocketship follows up, answers replies and books the meeting on your calendar, and keeps every reply, meeting and deal in one place. It also answers your calls, tracks the pipeline, and sends quotes and takes payment.

This plugin lets ChatGPT run the customer-finding part of that job inside your Rocketship account.

What ChatGPT can do today: describe who you sell to and see a preview of matching buyers by name, title and company, then add the ones you want to your workspace. Look up one specific person by first and last name, optionally at a company or in a city, and add them too. Finding someone's email is a separate step you choose.

See Conversations to reply to: the Reddit threads and Quora questions Rocketship found where people ask for what you sell, newest first, with why each one fits, the reply Rocketship drafted and the link to open the thread. ChatGPT never posts, comments or messages anywhere. You post each reply from your own account, or turn on Post for me in Rocketship and the Rocketship Chrome extension posts your Reddit replies from your own account, within a daily limit you set.

Put people on lists, search the people already in your workspace, and have ChatGPT write an email sequence (Email 1 plus follow-ups) that is saved as a draft for you to check. Ask who replied, what was sent, what is in your pipeline, and what needs attention today.

Start or pause a campaign: starting is always a separate, confirmed step because it sends real emails from your own connected Gmail. Emma, Rocketship's AI salesperson, then follows up, answers replies and books meetings on your Google Calendar. Every campaign stays within daily sending limits and stops for anyone who replies, books a meeting or unsubscribes.

Built for founders, startups and growing businesses. Everything happens in your own Rocketship workspace, with the same permissions as the app. You sign in with your Rocketship account (new users can create one while connecting) and can disconnect at any time in Settings.

defaultPrompt: Find leads: owners of dental practices in Austin, Texas. Show me a few.
How many marketing directors at software companies in New York could I sell to?
Help me find my first customers.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.8 changes the listing words only. The one-liner now reads Find leads, book sales calls, the first paragraph says plainly what Rocketship does (lead generation, B2B leads and prospects, cold emails from your own Gmail, booking sales calls), and the first example prompt starts with Find leads. No tool changes in this package.

positive.prompt: Give me today at a glance in Rocketship.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the workspace for today: what needs attention, replies waiting, emails sent today and meetings booked this week.

positive.prompt: Help me find my first customers.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT first asks who the person sells to (unless they already said it), then calls find_buyers with job titles, industries and a place. It shows about how many people match and a few of them by name, job title, company and place (no emails or phone numbers).

positive.description: Find a specific person by name
positive.prompt: Find a person named Dana Whitfield in Austin, Texas.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_buyers with person_name Dana Whitfield and location Austin, Texas, then shows the people by that name with title, company and place (no emails or phone numbers) and an id to add them, or says plainly that nobody by that name matched.

positive.prompt: Show me Reddit and Quora conversations I could reply to for my business.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the threads Rocketship found, newest first, each with its title, community, how new it is, fit and why it fits, the drafted reply (on Reddit also a private message, on plans that include drafts) and the link to open it, or says none are waiting. Nothing is posted by this request.

positive.prompt: Write a 3-email sequence for my Austin dental list and keep it as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a campaign with three emails for the Austin dental list as a draft, and says that nothing has been sent.

negative.prompt: Delete all my contacts in Rocketship.
Show me the Rocketship pipeline of a company I don't work for.
Send $500 from my Rocketship account to my bank account.
